0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The elderly miner is squinting at you with great intensity.

48.original: You there! New <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>! Where are the others?

49.original: Don't try to play me for a fool, I know what they're up to. No good, that's what! Expect me to pay them for shirking their duties, do they? Bah!

50.original: Go and get them, will you? It's time I gave them a stern talking to!

51.original: The youth of today, what a shower of shite! In my day we had it tough. We'd be woken up half a bell before we'd went to bed, eat a handful of hot gravel, and─ What are you still gawping at me for, you bloody fool!?

52.original: Ah gods, my aching head... I feel like death warmed up...

53.original: It seems the man is suffering from a hangover. If you were to <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>psych<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> him up, perhaps he might be more inclined to return to his duties.

54.original: All right, all right! Enough of your posing!

55.original: If going back to work's what it takes for you to leave me alone, so be it!

56.original: <sigh> Nothing's going my way... I haven't had a decent haul in ages. I might as well just hang up my pickaxe for good.

57.original: The man seems to be lacking in motivation. Perhaps if you were to <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>rally<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> his spirits, he might be willing to return to work.

58.original: I don't know who you are or what you're doing, but your enthusiasm is somehow...infectious!

59.original: Yes, I should be thankful for what I have! I've got a steady job, a sort of beautiful home, what more could I ask for? Heigh ho, heigh ho, it's back to work I go!

60.original: Why would she leave me? There's nothing for her in Eulmore! Whatever will I do now?

61.original: The man is clearly upset and in no fit state to work. If someone were to <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>comfort<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> him, he might come to his senses.

62.original: “There, there?” What does that even mean, anyway? <hex:021A020203>There<hex:021A020103> are people who need me? <hex:021A020203>There<hex:021A020103> is still work to be done?

63.original: That's it! I should forget my sorrows by burying myself in my work! Ah, a poor choice of words considering I'm a miner... But enough procrastinating, there's digging to be done!

64.original: Nothing cures a hangover better than spending hours smashing rocks in a dingy mine... Ungh. Kill me now.

65.original: Ha ha, those rocks won't know what hit them!

66.original: Who needs her anyway? I'm married to my job!

67.original: So, the four of you finally decided to show up and do some bloody work, then?

68.original: Four!? But this <hex:020811E905FF06776F6D616EFF06626C6F6B6503>'s not part of our team, is <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503>? As far as I can tell, <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503>'s just passing through!

69.original: Eh!? What are you prattling about now?

70.original: Ha ha! My mistake! When you get to my age, one person-shaped blur looks much like all the others. Must be these damned eyes of mine.

71.original: Still, we could use an extra pair of hands around here. I daresay you're worth more than all of these slack-jawed layabouts put together.

72.original: But if you're not here for the mining, you might as well take this as payment for rounding up my workers. Gods help me, they're all I've got.
